title: Happy path for three Ha Noi to Sa Pa tickets

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.content: I want to book 3 seats from Ha Noi to Sa Pa tonight.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.content: The available departure is 22:30 from My Dinh. The total is 1050000 VND and the deposit is 300000 VND.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.content: Policy BUS-V1 v1.0 refunds 80 percent of the deposit if cancellation is at least 12 hours before departure.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.content: I confirm 3 seats from Ha Noi to Sa Pa at 22:30, pickup at My Dinh, and I accept the deposit and refund policy.
